sources.entry: WonderCMS - WonderCMS is the smallest flat file CMS since 2008. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: WonderCMS is a small flat-file content management system written in PHP, described in its awesome-selfhosted listing as the smallest flat-file CMS since 2008.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies only on the awesome-selfhosted listing and repository metadata. The listing describes WonderCMS as a flat-file CMS, meaning content is stored in files rather than a database. It is written in PHP and released under the MIT license. The listing links a demo and the source code. No specific features beyond these are confirmed.
use_cases: simple content management without a database
notable: Flat-file CMS, so no database is described in the listing
Listed as the smallest flat-file CMS since 2008, per the awesome-selfhosted entry
Live demo available per the listing
caveats: README not available, so installation and features could not be verified
Size and age claims come from the awesome-selfhosted listing, not from the repository itself
keywords: build a website without a database
